newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P lowers Nomura Sec, affiliates long-term ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P lowers Nomura Sec, affiliates long-term ratings.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp (S&P) said on Thursday that it had lowered its long-term counterparty ratings for Nomura Securities Co Ltd and its affiliates to A+ from AA-.
The short-term debt and counterparty ratings for the Nomura group companies were also lowered to A-1 from A-1+, S&P said in a statement.
The outlook for the ratings is stable, it said.
S&P also removed Nomura's credit ratings from CreditWatch, which they were placed on September 19.
"The rating actions reflect the negative impact on Nomura's financial parameters from its extension of financial support to its affiliate Nomura Finance Co Ltd," the statement said.
